summary: 11 errors, 41 minor in 23 of 34 units. Regrouping suggested: 19c, 32c (formula joined to a verse), possibly the closing 'pṛthivi mātaḥ' of 23 and the 'madhumatīr ...' mantra at the end of 4. Units with no issue found: 2, 5, 6, 13, 14, 15, 16, 21, 26, 28, 29. Unit 9 (maryā?) and 22 (yamase?) text suspicions are from memory of parallel texts and need a witness.
